channel.title: Databases | System Design
channel.description: In-depth system design tutorials — from zero to millions of users. Written for engineers who want to understand how large-scale systems actually work.

item.title: Design a Hotel Reservation System
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Three reservations per second — and it is the hardest design in the series. Double booking, pessimistic versus optimistic locking, and the one-line fix the textbook leaves out. With an interactive race-condition simulator you can try to break.

item.title: Design a Proximity Service
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: How does 'restaurants near me' return results in under 100ms from 200 million businesses? Geohash, quadtrees, Google S2 and Uber's H3 explained from first principles — with an interactive geohash encoder you can play with, and the boundary bug that breaks the obvious implementation.
item.content:encoded:
How does 'restaurants near me' return results in under 100ms from 200 million businesses? Geohash, quadtrees, Google S2 and Uber's H3 explained from first principles — with an interactive geohash encoder you can play with, and the boundary bug that breaks the obvious implementation.

item.title: Design a URL Shortener
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Design a TinyURL-style service handling 100 million new links a day. Base62 encoding, why 7 characters is exactly right, the 301-versus-302 decision that quietly breaks your analytics, and the abuse problem the textbooks skip.

item.title: Design a Unique ID Generator in Distributed Systems
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: How to generate billions of unique, sortable, 64-bit IDs per day with no central coordination. Multi-master replication, UUIDs, ticket servers and Twitter Snowflake explained from first principles — plus UUIDv7, ULID and how to choose between them in 2026.

item.title: Scale From Zero to Millions of Users: A Complete System Design Walkthrough
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
